task_completion.description: Locate and select the paper 'Attention Is All You Need' by Vaswani et al. (2017) in the Zotero library.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The paper 'Attention Is All You Need' is highlighted or selected in the center pane of the Zotero interface.

task_completion.description: Initiate the creation of a child note for the selected paper.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Add Child Note' option is selected from a menu, or a new empty note editor appears in the right-hand pane linked to the paper.

task_completion.description: The note contains a meaningful summary of at least 2-3 sentences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The note editor shows a block of text that visually constitutes at least two distinct sentences.
The word 'Transformer' is visible within the text of the note in the Zotero interface.
The phrase 'self-attention' is visible within the text of the note in the Zotero interface.

task_completion.description: The note includes the concept 'machine translation' or 'translation'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The word 'translation' or 'machine translation' is visible within the text of the note in the Zotero interface.

integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero GUI to add the note rather than command-line database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Zotero menus and the note editor pane.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply type the keywords in isolation but wrote a coherent summary.
integrity.visual_evidence: The note text forms grammatical sentences rather than a comma-separated list of required keywords.

integrity.description: The note is correctly attached as a child of the Vaswani paper, not a different entry.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Zotero hierarchy in the center/right pane shows the note nested under the 'Attention Is All You Need' title.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target paper is 'Attention Is All You Need' by Vaswani et al. (2017). The note must contain at least 2-3 sentences and must include the specific terms: 'Transformer', 'self-attention', and either 'translation' or 'machine translation'. The note should be a child note of the specific paper in the Zotero library.
